claims.claim: TASK-170 changes exactly the permitted descriptor, integration test, lifecycle document, P6.1d report, and two roadmaps; no production Python or prior fixture authority is modified.

The compact P6.1d descriptor binds the exact published TASK-169 bytes, preserves all six ordered Human stress intents and labels, and the test transitively verifies TASK-168 provenance while reconstructing the canonical six-profile corpus through published authorities only.

Each complete replay invokes TASK-134 once per exact stress intent, records its exact planned query, then invokes TASK-164 once for all six cases at limit=3 and snapshots exact per-case and aggregate Fraction metrics.

The benchmark introduces no threshold or architecture decision and includes repeated complete offline execution with fresh SQLite catalogs, value-equal outputs, and byte-immutability checks for all bound fixtures and descriptors.

Phase documentation records the exact 12 TP, 0 FP, 0 FN, 1/1 precision and 1/1 recall result and authority boundary; both roadmaps close published P6.1c, make TASK-170 the P6.1d closure candidate, keep P6.2 decision-gated, and leave P6.3-P6.6 deferred.
